non_blocking_notes: All critical paths verified: budget exhaustion, isolation by (tenant, agent, tool), Evidence-failure rollback, and concurrent safety.
Budget counter initialization correct: .get(scope, 0) handles first-admission case properly.
Validation order correct: audit callable check before max_admissions_per_scope bounds.
result.reasoning_summary: Patch correctly implements FW-MCP-02 bounded admission budgets. Core isolation uses exact 3-tuple key (tenant_id, subject_agent_id, tool) preventing cross-tenant/agent/tool budget leakage. Concurrency safety ensured: all budget checks and increments occur within self._lock RLock block (mcp_gateway.py:115–144). Denial-before-Evidence ordering verified: budget exhaustion check (line 123) raises before audit invocation (line 126). Evidence-failure rollback working: budget increment (line 144) only executes after successful try block; on Exception, request_id removed from pending (line 139) and budget untouched. Auditable budget counters included in audit call with budget_used and budget_limit. Validation fail-closed: constructor rejects bool, 0, negative, >1024, and non-int. Five new test cases verify: budget exhaustion denial, configuration rejection, 4-way isolation, concurrent 8-thread safety (3-budget limit=3 admitted/5 denied), and rollback-on-Evidence-failure. Backward compatible: max_admissions_per_scope keyword-only with default MAX_ADMISSIONS_PER_SCOPE=1024. Scope stays within admission logic; no tool execution, transport, credentials, or response authority changes. All 119 tests pass. git diff --check passed. Patch narrow: only mcp_gateway.py, tests, and status updates.
